name: MadnessChat Button
author: madnesscode1

sections.description:
MadnessChat Button is a simple and free solution to integrate a WhatsApp chat button into your WordPress website. Perfect for blogs, small businesses, and personal projects.

✨ Basic Features

Easy Setup
* Single WhatsApp number
* Customizable pre-configured message
* Setup in less than 2 minutes

Button Customization
* 4 different styles (circle, square, pill, with text)
* 6 animations to grab attention
* 5 hover effects
* Icon selector
* Screen positioning

Responsive Configuration
* Different sizes per device (mobile, tablet, laptop, desktop)
* Separate configuration for each device type
* Automatic adaptation

Visibility Control
* Show/hide by device (mobile, desktop)
* Page selector (home, posts, pages)
* Basic triggers (delay, scroll, time on page)

Privacy
* Basic GDPR compliance
* Optional consent before opening WhatsApp
* Google Analytics integration (optional)

🎯 Ideal For

  • Personal blogs: Direct contact with readers
  • Portfolios: Quick inquiries about projects
  • Small businesses: Basic customer support
  • Local businesses: Reservations and inquiries
  • Freelancers: Immediate contact

🔄 Need More Features?

Pro Version
* Multiple agents with automatic rotation
* A/B Testing to optimize conversions
* Advanced analytics with dashboard
* Contextual messages per page
* Smart template system
* Priority support

Interested in the Pro version? Contact us at madnesscode1@gmail.com

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “MadnessChat Button”
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Select the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Initial Configuration

  1. Go to Chat Button in the administration menu
  2. Configure your WhatsApp number
  3. Customize the design and messages
  4. Done! The button will appear on your site
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it is compatible with all WordPress themes. The button is positioned absolutely and does not interfere with your theme’s design.

Can I use multiple WhatsApp numbers?

The basic version supports a single WhatsApp number. For multiple agents, consider the Pro version.

Does it affect site speed?

No, it is optimized and uses asynchronous loading techniques. It does not affect loading speed.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. It includes basic consent options before opening WhatsApp, complying with privacy regulations.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, it is fully optimized for mobile devices and automatically adapts to different screen sizes. You can configure different sizes and positions for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Can I customize colors and styles?

Yes, it includes customization with color pickers, 4 button styles, 6 animations, and 5 hover effects.

Is there technical support?

This is a free plugin. For priority support and advanced features, consider the Pro version.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Changed all prefixes from “mcnb” to “mcnb” to comply with WordPress naming conventions (minimum 4 characters)
  • Fixed security issues: all $_SERVER, $_POST, $_GET inputs are now properly sanitized and validated
  • Fixed internationalization: all menu titles and section titles now use English as base language
  • Fixed hook names to use proper plugin prefix
  • Renamed main plugin file to follow WordPress convention (madnesschat-button.php)
  • Improved code security and compliance with WordPress Coding Standards

1.0.1

Bug fixes and improvements. Fixed privacy settings saving, checkbox persistence, and visual effects preview.

1.0.0

First version of MadnessChat Button. Free plugin to add a WhatsApp button to your WordPress website.
